scope: Sony A6000 fw 3.21; static only; ELF addresses (Ghidra VA = ELF + 0x10000).

camera_liveview_unit_type.evidence: ModelBootEE only creates topologies {0x0a,0x07}: Camera(8) out0 -> Effect(9) in0 -> Renderer. No Camera->StillRecorder YC topology nor Camera allocation constant was recovered.

encodestill_compatibility.value: No demostrada para el buffer original de EE; la ruta PbCap sí crea el par {raster, SDS} que el recorder consume.
encodestill_compatibility.evidence: Execute validates/open both descriptors but not pixel format/stride; the unknown Camera type and SDS semantics preclude claiming direct compatibility.

producer_chain.evidence: topology 0x0a table: object 8 out0 -> object 9 in0; identity from pin signature, docs/capture/objhandover-2a-topology.md.
allocates dedicated descriptors then builds ObjMsg(0x2001,0x1003) with dec at 0x1031 and YC SDS at 0x1017.
opens descriptors to obtain extent totals, then calls MprCtrl::EncodeStill 0x8fe6f8.
copies the 16-word RegionInfo then calls this+4 vtable+0x20 and returns 0.

dec_buffer.evidence: 0x15fa74 Dmm allocate at +0x60; 0x15ebfc stores {handle,+0x64; unitType 0x50b3f; phys,+0x70} into PlayData 0x1032.

yc_sds.evidence: 0x15fa74 Dmm allocate at +0x78; 0x15ebfc stores it into PlayData 0x1018 and constructs accessor with length 0x800.

super_resolution_dec.evidence: 0x15f37c allocates 0x243 and 0xe0b00; 0x15ebfc selects it when flag +0xc4 != 0.

unknown: link semantics between SDS descriptor and raster

region.evidence: 0x15ebfc writes it to 0x1038; 0x1019 and 0x101a receive the same dimensions for SDS.

operation.value: ObjMsg(0x3900,0x3000) SDF resize/rotate; alternate super-resolution path
operation.evidence: 0x15fa74 builds 0x3900/0x3000 after preparing both unit descriptors; 0x15f37c closes both output allocations after setup.

plane_layout_stride.evidence: neither RegionInfo nor Execute has pitch, plane-count, or pixel-format validation.

recorder_input.evidence: 0x90ad20 does DmmOpen/DmmClose solely to accumulate extent sizes; it neither DmmShare nor DmmFree's YC or dec input.

fea_completion.evidence: FeaIf::EncodeStill 0x44f834 enqueues and returns 0; strings/callback flow identify CBID_ENCODE_STILL as completion notification.

safe_release.evidence: the enqueue gives no proof of when FEA starts/finishes reading; callback is the only recovered completion signal.

effect_release_time.evidence: allocation is proven at 0x15fa74/0x15f37c, but no post-CBID free of these input units was recovered.

kernel.evidence: validates handle serial (0x9cb8..0x9cc4), status 1..3 (0x9cd8..0x9ce8), expected unit type at unit+0x298 (0x9cfc..0x9d08), then increments alloc byte unit+0x2a0 (0x9d1c..0x9d44).

caller.evidence: ObjScalar bridge 0x3eed34 calls DmmCh::allocShare before retaining client descriptors.

dmm_share.limit: Share protects only DMM alloc-refcount based Free. It does not prove that a Camera/EE ring will not recycle contents by another mechanism.
dmm_share.state: VERIFICADO mechanism / NO VERIFICADO for EE-ring protection

rejected_claims.claim: the Live View Camera unit is 0xe0b00
rejected_claims.evidence: 0xe0b00 has one 0x800-byte extent and is used as the SDS descriptor alongside a separate raster unit.
dmm_unit_ctrl_Close 0xa34c decrements unit+0x2a1; DmmFree uses alloc unit+0x2a0.

rejected_claims.claim: FeaIf return 0 means encoding is finished
rejected_claims.evidence: libmpr 0x44f834 calls queue vtable+0x20 then immediately returns 0.
